ns2:course.label: Creative Concepts II
ns2:course.description: This portfolio-oriented course builds upon the core competencies acquired in ADV 452 and applies them to solving real-world advertising problems with integrated creative consumer communications efforts than span traditional and new media. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ADV 452.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ADV 452.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Agricultural Communications major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
